From: Sara Mills <finance@aurorahealth.com>

Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com, alyssa.chen@aurorahealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Annual prepay planning - request for Gantt and VAT evidence

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to lock in the annual prepay/committed spend plan for FY28 and need two things to move forward with procurement: a simple Gantt showing deposit vs withdrawal windows (month-level) so our treasury team can forecast, and a short VAT/entity evidence checklist we can attach to the PO.

Can you send a single-page Gantt and a list of the documents Aurora needs to provide (VAT IDs, invoicing remit instructions, entity names, any local tax forms)? Ideally by EOD Monday so we can circulate to legal/procurement.

Also: is it possible to split the invoice into 3 staggered invoices (deposit, mid-year, year-end)? If so, include proposed invoice dates and sample invoice numbers so our AP can match quickly.

PO/Procurement contact here is Alyssa Chen (cc'd) and I'll be coordinating the PO submission.

Appreciate it — Sara

--
Sara Mills
Director, Finance Operations

Thanks — happy to put that together. Attached is a preliminary one-page Gantt (Aurora-prepay-gantt-v1.xlsx) that shows:
- Deposit (Invoice 1): 2027-07-01 (due on receipt)
- Mid-year withdrawal (Invoice 2): 2028-01-02
- Year-end settlement / reconciliation (Invoice 3): 2028-07-01

I've looped in Karthik (billing lead), Kimberly (tax/vat), and Jonas (finance ops) to confirm the invoice numbering scheme and to produce the VAT evidence checklist.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Internal: Karthik/Kimberly/Jonas confirm invoice dates, sample invoice numbers, and whether we can do 3 invoices against the committed amount.
2) External: Sara/Alyssa confirm PO lead time and preferred remit bank. If Aurora wants escrow/locked deposit routing, call that out now.
3) We'll attach the VAT entity checklist (one-pager) to the PO and include the invoice sample with expected line items.

I'll wait for internal confirmation and will send the final PDF checklist and a CSV invoicing calendar you can ingest.

Cheers,

Hannah / team —

Quick internal note and proposed concrete schedule. I put together a CSV export (invoicing-calendar.csv) with the dates below and sample invoice numbers we can program into our billing system:

Proposed staggered invoice plan (committed amount = $1,200,000):
- Invoice 1 (Deposit, 60%): 2027-07-01 — Invoice #: RDW-AUR-2027-001 — Amount: $720,000
- Invoice 2 (Mid-year drawdown, 25%): 2028-01-02 — Invoice #: RDW-AUR-2028-002 — Amount: $300,000
- Invoice 3 (Year-end settlement, 15%): 2028-07-01 — Invoice #: RDW-AUR-2028-003 — Amount: $180,000 (final reconciliation)

VAT / tax notes (Kimberly, please confirm):
- Aurora is in the US; for any EU/AU entities we need entity-level VAT IDs. If Aurora will invoice through a non-US subsidiary for any region, we need the local VAT registration certificates.
- We support reverse-charge and zero-rated handling but need the signed VAT-entity mapping (vat-entity-mapping.pdf) returned for our records.

Bank remit / PO mapping: please confirm Aurora's remit account and PO number so Jonas can set the ledger mapping. Jon, can you confirm whether we need a separate remit for escrow or if we can do a single account?

I will freeze these invoice numbers once we have PO and remit details.
